scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix shared && npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.verify: npm run build:shared && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
